body:
Well the night before the turny I am playing Star Trek Armada and Axis and allies all night and trying to thing of some deck. Well I was thinking what should i play first I thought that i should play barnges. Then I said hell no Because i saw Mwyhl last week so i said no way. Then I thought of the watto obj I said what the hell why not. For light side between wys beats and anger fear racing. So then at the last min anger fear racing.

I live about 45 mins to the closes turny man it sucks to live in the boonedocks.

 I arive at champion cards and comics listing to that ne pod song.



COme in play a little raw deal to man i love kurt angel.













First game

My light side anger fear racing vs court racing



First this is a tuff match up.

Man this guy just went off by the next anger fear but he won the race and that was that it was hard fought he had that damn tuskin raider at the arena for one thing that is tech. Did some hit a run attacks but wasnt enought.

FL BY (0)-8





Second game



My Watto vs hidden base toys

Always get sleep before a turny for got to start the box but what can you do. by the 5th turn win the race and fighting baqck and fourth never deployed anything he kept losing two crazy. That was a hard but one big battle decided it. I came out on top. full win by 7



Full win (2)-1



Played a little raw deal angel won with the angel slam.





Third Game



Anger fear racing Vs Senators



Easy game just won the race bossh at the chamber and own mauls site with the spy and make him lose to anger fear.

Very easy game won by 39



Full Win (4)+38



More raw deal full win agian.





Last Game

watto vs hidden base with kessel runs



Won the race but forget to activate to aim high was almost my down fall but one big space battle with zucckus in ship and ig88 in ship with 4 lom aginst lando and railter freighter capt who one and next turn probe for watto its tuff to win if he pulls off a run and cambo screat plans dosent come out till the end but search and destory is god

Full win by 6



Final (6)+44



Props

anger fear total for a total of 28 force loss in a game

Dark side went 2 and 0

won all the raw deal



Slops

No real raw deal competion

Light side loss

and no big wins with the dark

And no good food places within walking distance



Well next week i ll be going to buford Ga and i hope that i can win with my light side their

summary: Damian Loback went 3–1 (6, +44) at a tournament at Champion Cards and Comics, Smyrna, Georgia, on 6 October 2001, with an Anger Fear racing Light deck and a Watto Dark deck, losing only his first game to Court racing.
notes: Event named 'October 2001 Smyrna tournament' (no October 2001 Smyrna event on the List); date and city from the title (Smyrna GA 10-6-01), store from the body ('champion cards and comics').
No opponent is named; opponent fields are null.
Format Premiere - Coruscant (October 2001; the Watto objective is a Coruscant card; no Reflections III cards or Defensive Shields mentioned).

Dark 'watto obj' linked to No Money, No Parts, No Deal!; opponents' 'court racing' to Court Of The Vile Gangster and the two 'hidden base' decks to Hidden Base. 'Anger fear racing' and 'Senators' name no objective.

deck_page left null: [[Damian Loback Light Side Racing (done the tech way)]] (posted 14 October 2001, 4x Anger, Fear, Aggression, Podrace Prep) is probably his Light deck here, but the report does not tie the post to this event.
Running totals: game 3 'won by 39' but the tally reads (4)+38; final '(6)+44' kept as author_points.
No finish or player count given. The report also mentions Raw Deal games played on the side (not SWCCG, not recorded).
